scenarios.title: Protect the finish
scenarios.objective: Bring both damaged cars home; compare a repair with protecting the current run.
scenarios.hint: Disclosed starting condition: MER has 40 aggregate damage and 72% lifetime health; MOR has 20 damage and 78% health. Calm incidents suppress new random faults, not wear. A repair removes damage at a real cost but never restores health or tyres. Pit ownership starts manual; nobody is guaranteed a result.

scenarios.title: Is the repair worth it?
scenarios.objective: Weigh small damage against the full pit loss in a short race.
scenarios.hint: Disclosed starting condition: MER has 8 damage / 88% health and MOR 12 damage / 85% health. Four laps leave little time to earn back a stop. Read the break-even estimate, keep or protect the current run, or pay for a physical repair. No mandatory stop and no outcome script.
